title: Pairing a Sum of Single-Entry Matrices
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{terms}$ be a finite list of pairs of indices in $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$, and let $z$ be a vector of length $N$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Pairing the sum of the single-entry matrices specified by the listed pairs with the matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry is $z_i z_j$ equals the sum, over the list, of $z_i z_j$ for each listed pair $(i,j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{terms}$ is a finite list of pairs of indices in $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$
$z$ is a vector of length $N$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$
